biggest_catch: Only $5 per approved test, your first payout needs a $10 balance (two approved tests), and the unpaid qualification test must pass review before you earn anything.
catches: Zero guaranteed tests — invites depend on client demand and your profile; test volume is variable.
Screening and qualification: each test invite includes a screener you can be rejected from.
Unpaid entry test: the qualification test is unpaid and must pass review before you receive paid tests.
Only approved tests pay — a rejected test earns $0.
First payout requires a $10 balance (two approved tests); later payouts need at least $5.
Approved tests pend for 7 days before payout can be requested; payouts take 5-10 business days.
PayPal is the only payout method — no bank transfer or gift card options.
Effective hourly pay is low: $5 for 5-20 minutes of work, with no steady hours.

steps: Sign up at userbrain.com and download the Userbrain Recorder for Google Chrome, iOS, or Android.
Record the unpaid qualification test (a tour and guide are provided first).
Wait for Userbrain to review your video and give feedback.
Once approved as a Userbrain tester, start receiving paid test invites.
For each paid test, spend 5-20 minutes completing the tasks while speaking your thoughts aloud, then submit.
Request a payout to your PayPal account once your balance reaches $10 (first payout); approved tests pend 7 days and payouts are handled within 5-10 business days.
